extracts.cost: No API credits: one SEC re-read.
extracts.unlocks: Market cap, Shares out, Book value/share, Net cash / share, Short % out

extracts.from: SEC data: ShortTermInvestments, MarketableSecuritiesCurrent, AvailableForSaleSecuritiesDebtSecuritiesCurrent, added to secfacts.js, one re-read (the release already gives it)

extracts.unlocks: Cash on the same footing as Twelve Data’s total cash, Net cash

extracts.item: The rest of the debt lines

extracts.unlocks: One defined total debt: Debt, Net cash, Debt / equity, Enterprise value and the multiples on it

extracts.item: The dividend declared per share, with its record and payment dates

rows.label: Market Cap
rows.equivalent: Diluted shares (weighted average) × price
rows.note: The release gives the quarter’s weighted-average diluted shares, not shares outstanding today, so this is near, not equal. Market value is the one money figure reliably in dollars; the Signal reads it.

sec.equivalent: Diluted shares for the quarter × price

best.why: Shares outstanding today times the price; the filings give the quarter’s diluted average, which lags buybacks and issuance. Measured: SEC agrees with Twelve Data on 35.6%, the release on 35.5%.

proposal.text: Keep Twelve Data until shares outstanding are extracted; then price × the cover-page count is an exact alternative. A Signal input: changing its source is the owner’s decision.

rows.label: Revenue TTM
rows.equivalent: Revenue, four releases summed
rows.shown: Quarter only: Last Earning AI Extracted › Revenue
rows.note: Banks and insurers headline net revenue where the filings and Twelve Data total it: most of the disagreement.

best.why: The filing itself, so exact. SEC filings carry it for 1,076 companies; Twelve Data agrees on 83.1% within 2% (median gap 0%), most of the rest is banks and insurers (net revenue against total). The release matches the 10-Q 90.6% within 0.5%, a median 1 day before the 10-Q (13 for the slowest tenth). Use it until the 10-Q is in.

proposal.text: SEC four quarters, the release while the 10-Q is pending; Twelve Data where neither has it.

rows.label: FCF TTM

rows.shown: Quarter only: Last Earning AI Extracted › FCF; stock page card

best.why: Two measures: Twelve Data’s levered free cash flow, or operating cash flow less capex (SEC filings, exact; the release until the 10-Q). The Signal reads Twelve Data’s today. Measured: SEC agrees with Twelve Data on 3.2%, the release on 2.5%.

proposal.text: Decide the measure first: levered (Twelve Data) or operating cash flow less capex (SEC, release first). If unlevered, call it “FCF TTM” and add “Levered FCF” as its own column if wanted. A Signal input: changing its source is the owner’s decision.

rows.label: EBITDA

rows.note: Only where the release prints it, and then usually the company’s ADJUSTED EBITDA under its own name. No filing figure to check against.

proposal.text: Build it as operating income plus depreciation and amortization from the filings, twelve months; until then keep Twelve Data. The companies’ adjusted EBITDA stays a release-only figure, labelled as theirs.

rows.label: Operating cash
